question: Who among the following won the Gold Medal in 2020 Paralympics and Silver in 2024 Paralympics in Shooting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manish Narwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Manish Narwal earned a silver medal in the men’s 10m air pistol SH1 event with a score of 234.9 points, showcasing resilience after briefly dropping to sixth place.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India secured a record 29 medals at the Paris 2024 Paralympics: 7 gold, 9 silver, and 13 bronze.
 
• This performance surpasses the 19 medals won at Tokyo 2020, including 5 golds.
 
• India crossed the 50-medal mark in its Paralympic history.
 
• A record 84 para-athletes represented India at Paris 2024, competing across 12 disciplines.
 
• Three new sports were added: para cycling, para rowing, and blind judo.
 
• Avani Lekhara became the first Indian woman to win two gold medals at a single Paralympic Games, setting a world record in the women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 event.
